name: Oxford Spires (MrHash LiDAR, corrected poses)
description: Server-managed Oxford LiDAR bag with completed GLIM T_world_lidar poses corrected to MrHash bag-record lookup timestamps.

input_manifest.pose_file_format: bag_record_timestamp tx ty tz qx qy qz qw

timebase.pose_selection: nearest GLIM pose by physical LiDAR first-point timestamp
timebase.note: The timestamp column is a MrHash lookup key; it is not the original GLIM trajectory timestamp.

input_manifest.data_source: Oxford Spires ROS1 bag and externally completed GLIM trajectory; corrected association prepared on this server
